heading: Find affordable housing in New Jersey
search_instructions: Browse New Jersey rental listings and connect with local assistance programs, lottery options, and Section 8 vouchers.
why: Why use the NJ Housing Resource Center?
introduction: The NJ Housing Resource Center (NJHRC) is the state's central listing site for affordable housing. It's a free, reliable website that helps you find housing quickly and easily. This trusted site also helps you check whether the programs you're eligible for are accepted. If you don't qualify for a specific program, you can still keep searching for affordable options that fit your needs.
